candidates.source_name: Komerční banka – Hospodářské výsledky (quarterly results archive 2000–present)

Year-collapsible archive back to 2000 carrying, per quarter: results presentation PDF, Czech commentary on business results, consolidated IFRS financial statements (PDF and XLSX), individual statements with audit report, and a 'facts and figures' spreadsheet. negative_findings.description: Only one of the four banks in this cell — Komerční banka — runs a full equity-style IR operation. KB has its own PSE-listed shares and therefore a financial calendar, results presentations, conference calls, a ratings page, a key-figures/fact-book page and a general-meeting record. Česká spořitelna, ČSOB and UniCredit Bank CZ&SK have no listed local equity; their local IR surfaces are thinner and centre on statutory reports plus press releases.
negative_findings.result_summary: Extensive cs and en searching found no local quarterly results presentation deck, no earnings call and no analyst-facing fact book for ČS, ČSOB or UniCredit Bank CZ&SK. The presentation layer for ČS sits at Erste Group and for ČSOB at KBC Group; UniCredit Bank CZ&SK has no equivalent at all beyond UniCredit SpA group reporting.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed four comparable structured IR estates with results presentations, fact books and earnings calendars. That holds only for KB. Any collection design that templates 'four banks, same artefact set' will produce three quarters of empty slots. The correct model is: KB local-complete; ČS and ČSOB local-statutory plus parent-group analytical; UniCredit CZ&SK local-statutory only.

negative_findings.description: Every csob.cz URL attempted this session returned HTTP 500 to WebFetch, across three different paths: /portal/csob/vztahy-k-investorum, /csob/povinne-uverejnovane-informace and /csob/servis-pro-media/tiskove-zpravy.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three of three fetches failed with HTTP 500. The same pages are indexed by search engines with current content, and ČSOB PDFs on /documents/10710/ are reachable in search results, so the site is live and serving. Recorded as a fetch-method problem, not a dead source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ČSOB Group is one of the three largest Czech banking groups; losing it would gut the cell. The blocker is almost certainly header or user-agent filtering on a Liferay portal rather than a real outage, so a headless browser with realistic headers should recover it. Must not be marked dead on this evidence.

negative_findings.description: All unicreditbank.cz HTML pages attempted returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to WebFetch, both the English and Czech annual-reports pages and the debt investor relations page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two of two fetches returned 403. PDFs on the same domain under /content/dam/cee2020-pws-cz/ are indexed and were surfaced with current content by search, which indicates page-level bot defence rather than an unreachable host.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The document layer is templatable (VZ-YYYY-CZ.pdf, Pololetni-zprava-YYYY-CZE.pdf), so the reports remain collectable via direct asset paths even if the HTML index stays gated. The index page is still needed to discover new filename variants and any prospectus documents.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language investor-relations landing page could be found for UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia. Czech searches on 'vztahy s investory', 'pro investory' and 'tiskové zprávy' scoped to unicreditbank.cz returned only report PDFs and third-party media coverage.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language queries surfaced statutory PDFs and an iROZHLAS tag page, but no unicreditbank.cz IR hub or press-release listing. The only investor-facing page located was English-language Debt Investor Relations.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For this issuer, Czech-language monitoring has to fall back to third-party media and to the Czech editions of the statutory PDFs. There is no local-language IR narrative channel to track, which is itself a finding about how this bank communicates in the CZ market.

negative_findings.description: No RSS, Atom or JSON feed was identified on any of the four banks' IR or press sections.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetches and searches across kb.cz, csas.cz, csob.cz and unicreditbank.cz surfaced no feed endpoint. KB and ČS both expose dated permalink structures that support diff-based change detection instead; ČS additionally has a JSON-backed document SPA whose backing endpoint may serve as a de facto feed if reversed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection has to be poll-and-diff rather than feed-driven, which raises cost and makes the financial calendars materially more valuable as scheduling inputs. Worth a dedicated check for feed endpoints during the verification pass before committing to polling everywhere.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Pillar 3 / capital adequacy disclosure page was located for any of the four banks, despite targeted Czech searching on 'Pilíř 3' and 'uveřejňování informací'.
negative_findings.result_summary: KB's Povinně uveřejňované informace hub lists six children, none of them a Pillar 3 page; the prudential disclosures appear to be folded into 'Informace o bance' or into the annual report. Equivalent pages for the other three were not reachable or not found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pillar 3 tables are the richest comparable prudential dataset across banks (capital ratios, RWA breakdowns, NPL and forbearance, ESG risk templates). If they are embedded in annual-report annexes rather than published standalone, extraction is a PDF-parsing problem rather than a download problem, which changes the collection design and cost.

coverage_gaps.description: Two parent-group IR estates relevant to this cell were not located to a confirmed URL: Société Générale (60% owner of Komerční banka, which reports KB inside International Retail Banking) and UniCredit SpA (parent of UniCredit Bank CZ&SK). Both were referenced only indirectly through third-party coverage in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted en and fr/it searches for the SG and UniCredit SpA investor-relations report pages and confirm the exact quarterly-results paths, then add them alongside the Erste and KBC entries. Deliberately not guessed here rather than recorded as invented URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: Česká spořitelna's entire document estate sits behind a client-side SPA at /cs/dokumenty-ke-stazeni with numeric category IDs in the URL fragment. Category IDs were captured for 2022–2026 results sets, results presentations (18) and Debt Investors & MREL (1124), but the full category registry and the backing data endpoint are unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Drive the SPA once with a headless browser to enumerate every category ID and label, and capture the XHR the app issues so future collection can hit the JSON endpoint directly. Persist the ID-to-label registry, since the year categories get a fresh ID annually.

coverage_gaps.description: Earnings-call audio, webcasts and transcripts were confirmed only at parent-group level (Erste publishes audio and video webcasts per quarter). Whether Komerční banka publishes its own conference-call recording or transcript, and where, was not established — the financial calendar page references investor events but the artefact itself was not located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the KB financial calendar and a recent KB results permalink specifically hunting for a webcast/replay link or transcript PDF. Also check whether third-party transcript aggregators are the only route, which would raise a licensing question worth flagging before collection.

coverage_gaps.description: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia is a single legal entity covering both markets and files under both Czech and Slovak law, but this run's language scope is cs and en only. Slovak-language disclosure surfaces on unicreditbank.sk were seen in passing (annual report PDFs under /content/dam/cee2020-pws-sk/) and not pursued. The same applies to ČSOB's Slovak arm following the 365.bank combination.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Either extend language scope to sk for these two issuers specifically, or record explicitly that CZ-attributable figures for UniCredit Bank CZ&SK must be derived from segment notes rather than headline entity figures — otherwise the Slovak balance sheet will silently contaminate CZ market sizing.

coverage_gaps.description: ESEF/XBRL machine-readable filings were confirmed only for Komerční banka, from 2020 onward. Whether ČS, ČSOB or UniCredit Bank CZ&SK publish ESEF packages — and if so where — is unknown, since ESEF obligation attaches to issuers with securities on a regulated market, which all four have via debt even where equity is unlisted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check each issuer's mandatory-disclosure page for an ESEF or XBRL package alongside the PDF annual report. If absent locally, check whether the Prague Stock Exchange or CNB central storage holds the filings, which would give a single structured-format entry point for the whole cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Two obvious pointer estates were repeatedly implied by evidence but not scouted, as they sit outside this cell: the Prague Stock Exchange / PSE issuer disclosure pages and the Czech National Bank's central storage of regulated information, which is the statutory repository the kurzy.cz and patria.cz mirrors appear to draw from.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm another scout owns the PSE and CNB central-storage cell. If nobody does, they should be added — a single regulated-information repository would de-risk the csob.cz and unicreditbank.cz bot-defence problems for the whole cell at once.

brief: The four systemic Czech banks do not form the symmetric IR estate the cell brief assumed. Komerční banka is the only one with locally listed equity and it behaves accordingly: a complete IR hub with a results archive back to 2000 carrying presentations, IFRS statements and machine-readable facts-and-figures spreadsheets, ESEF/XBRL annual reports back to 2020, a financial calendar, a ratings page and a full general-meeting record — comfortably the richest single node in the cell. The other three publish locally only what statute requires: Česká spořitelna routes everything through a JavaScript document repository with stable numeric category IDs, ČSOB publishes results as dated tzYYMMDD.pdf press releases plus a late-April annual report, and UniCredit Bank CZ&SK offers annual and half-year PDFs on a fully templatable CDN path with no Czech-language IR page at all. Their analytical layer lives at the parents, so Erste Group and KBC Group are not optional extras but load-bearing sources for ČS and ČSOB respectively, each publishing a quarterly Czech Republic segment. Two collection caveats dominate: csob.cz returned HTTP 500 and unicreditbank.cz HTTP 403 on every HTML fetch this session while their PDFs remain search-indexed, so both are bot-defended-but-live hypotheses for the verification pass rather than dead sources; and UniCredit Bank CZ&SK's figures are a merged Czech-Slovak entity that must be segmented before any CZ market sizing.
